input.text: Hey Mike — I don't have access to any CRM or deal-tracking data in this channel, so I can't pull up the status on the Umbrella deal. You'll want to check your deal pipeline directly, or loop in whoever's been working that account. Happy to help if there's something more specific I *can* look into!
